messages:
li: quick note, int8 canary v3 ran overnight — seeing a new class of malformed JSON: model emits valid JSON then adds plain-text commentary on the next line.
li: parse_fail_rate ~1.4% but malformed-with-extra-text spike at 0.9% (was 0.0% baseline).
canary-bot: Canary alert: /structured-invoke extra_text_rate = 0.87% over 6k samples at 2024-11-09T02:15:00Z.
anya: example?
li: pasted:
```
{"command": "update", "payload": {"id": 77}}
Note: updated successfully.
```
li: another:
```
{"action":"create","args":{"name":"ACME"}}
-- logs: created id=8812
```
sam: hmm model seems to append a sentence after JSON, maybe from instruction-following objective. int8 could be shifting end-of-sequence logits causing an extra output token that triggers a newline + text.
omar: did we enable stop sequences?
li: stop_tokens set to ["\n\n"] for that route, but model emits single newline then text.
anya: quick fix: expand stop set to include single newline OR enforce max_tokens to 1 post-JSON and trim. But need conservative approach.
sam: canary harness should also include a post-output linter: if trailing non-JSON characters detected, mark as MALFORMED_EXTRA_TEXT and attempt to strip from first non-whitespace char after parsed JSON.
omar: test if this happens only on long contexts — correlation?
li: yes, >800 tokens context correlates with 78% of extra-text cases.
anya: action items:
- @sam add post-lint strip heuristic and telemetry counters (due: 48h)
- @li reproduce on local debug with deterministic decoding and collect token logits around EOS (due: EOD)
- @omar toggle stop-seq to include single-newline for canary and run 10k prompts (due: tomorrow)
- @anya prepare fallback routing to fp16 for sustained extra_text_rate > 0.5% (due: 72h)
li: also think about prompt engineering: append explicit "END_JSON" sentinel and require model to output that, then parse up to sentinel. Might be robust.
sam: sentinel helps but leaks into app protocol; need to ensure SDK strips sentinel safely.
canary-bot: Canary re-run scheduled after config changes at 2024-11-09T05:00:00Z.
li: thanks all — I will attach the reproduction script link soon.
omar: +1, keep ops informed if we shift traffic.
